name: Firebase Firestore
subtitle: Managed NoSQL document database
creator: Firebase team at Google
description: A document database with realtime listeners, offline sync on mobile and web, automatic scaling, and Security Rules that control access directly from the client. It is the successor to the original Firebase Realtime Database.

languages.youWrite: SDK calls in JS/TS, Swift, Kotlin or Dart, plus the Security Rules language

concepts.explanation: onSnapshot pushes changes as they happen.
Duplicate data because there are no joins.
Reads and writes work without a connection.

codeSamples.label: JavaScript

pros: Realtime and offline out of the box
cons: Costs per read and write can spike
Complex data needs a SQL database

pricing.summary: Spark plan: free daily quotas. Blaze plan: pay per read, write and GB stored.
